decisions.reason: A complete same-message MODIFY already qualifies the aggregate ticket count with the mint #1 exception; no additional change is required.
A complete same-message MODIFY already records that random no-referral commissions begin after mint #1 and are not required for the first mint.
A complete same-message MODIFY already records that no ticket is awarded when mint #1 has no earlier NFT available for random selection.
The accepted one-off first-mint accounting exception does not require changing the forward-facing FAQ behavior for later mints with existing NFT holders.
Mint #1 receives neither a random ticket nor a random commission, so the metadata rules for displaying credited rewards and matching ticket/commission counts remain valid.
The source decision concerns mint #1 without an earlier holder, not ticket issuance for a successful mint using a valid referral code.
The first-mint exception concerns randomly allocated no-referral commissions and does not change commissions paid when a valid referral code is used.
The current About-page process copy describes completed referrals and later prize activity; the accepted historical first-mint exception does not necessarily change that copy.
The source decision does not change which referral codes are valid or any validation feedback.
The first-mint commission exception does not change how an NFT's permanent referral code is derived, displayed, shared, or transferred.
The absence of a randomly assigned ticket and commission for mint #1 does not change Small Block funding, sales counting, draw thresholds, prize amounts, or ticket-cycle rules.
The source qualifies first-mint referral-commission accounting but does not specify any change to the $15 revenue split or the destination of the first mint's $5 commission share.
